name: Reflecting Iwan
summary: An open oblique court gathers around a quiet reflecting pool, with a tall mosque portal at the far corner.
why: The minaret, courtyard walls and high pointed iwan form one connected structure. The pool follows the court plane and stays clear of the surrounding wall. The portal opening shares x=69 with its roof; its base joins the far court wall.
risk: The high iwan replaces a familiar central dome. At 24px the reflecting pool reads as a single quiet colored center; the open court is clearest at 48px and above.
sub1: A reflecting pool follows the architecture
sub2: A high iwan marks the prayer hall
reasonToChoose: An open oblique court gathers around a quiet reflecting pool, with a tall mosque portal at the far corner.
